name: Mercado Pago
description: Connect Mercado Pago so the agent can find the payment behind an order, resend an unpaid Pix code to a verified customer, refund within what was paid and report refund status honestly.

mercadopago_get_payment.label: Get Payment
mercadopago_get_payment.description: Get a Mercado Pago payment: status, method, amount, refunds and dates. Never includes the Pix code.

mercadopago_find_payments.label: Find Payments for an Order
mercadopago_find_payments.description: Find the Mercado Pago payments behind a WooCommerce or Shopify order.

mercadopago_resend_payment.label: Resend Pix Code
mercadopago_resend_payment.description: Get the Pix code or payment link of an unpaid payment, only after the customer's email or phone matches the payer.

mercadopago_refund.label: Refund Payment
mercadopago_refund.description: Refund all or part of a paid payment, never more than what is still refundable. Moves money.

mercadopago_refund_status.label: Check Refund Status
mercadopago_refund_status.description: Check each refund of a payment: pending, completed or failed, with amount and date.

clientId.label: OAuth client ID
clientId.description: Set by the Hay.chat server. Leave empty unless you run your own Hay.chat server with your own Mercado Pago application.

clientSecret.label: OAuth client secret
clientSecret.description: Set by the Hay.chat server. Leave empty unless you run your own Hay.chat server.
